講座主題: Teaching with Artificial Intelligence in Humanly Intelligent Ways

講者: Prof. Richard Kern

時間: 5/13(二) 15:10-17:00

地點: 人社二館 A107 / A107, Humanities and Social Sciences Building II
 


講座簡介:

隨著人工智慧旋風似地重塑教育現場，語言中心邀請到加州大學柏克萊分校Richard Kern教授到校演講，引領東華師生一同思考教師、學習者與科技在其中不斷演變的角色。無論你對 AI 在課堂中的應用感到好奇、懷疑，或充滿期待，歡迎全校師生一起來與Kern 教授討論，如何在高教現場迎接轉變，但仍能維持高等教育中最核心的人性價值。

As AI rapidly reshapes the educational landscape, this timely talk invites university professors and students to reflect on the evolving role of educators, learners, and technology. Whether you're curious, cautious, or excited about AI’s place in the classroom, Prof. Kern will spark valuable conversations on how we can navigate these changes thoughtfully—keeping the human element at the heart of higher education. All disciplines welcome!


講者介紹:

Richard Kern 教授現為加州大學柏克萊分校法文系主任，他的研究聚焦於識讀能力培養、科技與跨文化溝通。作為電腦輔助語言學習領域的領軍人物，他啟發了全球眾多教育者重新思考數位時代的語言教學方式。

Prof. Richard Kern is a distinguished scholar in language education and digital media at the University of California, Berkeley. His research focuses on literacy, technology, and intercultural communication. As a leading voice in CALL (Computer-Assisted Language Learning), he has inspired educators worldwide to rethink language teaching in the digital age.
